data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding balance was $50.033m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net favourable prioryear development of approximately $2.12m (a ~4.2% release compared with opening gross reserves), driven by favourable claims development on the 2018 and 2019 underwriting years. The managing agent nonetheless reports a small net deterioration of $0.427m within the net calendar year claims charge (this reflects reinsurance effects). The exposures are predominantly Property Treaty reinsurance and movements have been influenced by catastrophe activity in North America and recoveries under the retrocession programme.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are reported in the syndicate's native currency (USD) and given in millions. Field names contain '_gbp_m' per schema but values are USD millions (not converted). Prior-year development gross figure was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 36). The report also states a net deterioration of $0.427m (quoted within the net calendar year claims incurred) - that net figure differs from the gross triangle-based release (gross release  $2.119m) due to reinsurance effects; the report does not provide an explicit gross prior-year movement line, so the gross triangle was used (confidence 0.8).
